events.continuity_hook: Begins the next spring site-visit episode after Cleveland travel is complete.
events.interaction_goal: Build a compact comparison of Chicago-Birmingham flight and hotel pairings, including arrival buffer, Thursday return timing, local transportation assumptions, estimated totals, breakfast, in-room coffee and refrigerator details, dinner access, and cancellation terms.
events.scenario_brief: After the Cleveland visit wraps, Marisol starts planning an April 13-15 Birmingham grant-site visit built around a Tuesday late-afternoon check-in at a downtown civil-rights arts center, a Wednesday morning youth media program in Avondale, and a Thursday funder debrief downtown expected to finish near noon. Current constraints are flying from Chicago, avoiding a rental car if rideshares are practical, finding a two-night hotel near downtown or UAB, and returning Thursday after lunch without getting home late. No bookings exist, and the unresolved question is whether a downtown base is worth more than a cheaper airport-area or UAB-adjacent stay.

events.continuity_hook: Narrows Birmingham lodging once the Wednesday and Thursday meeting geography is clearer.
events.interaction_goal: Update the hotel comparison by total lodging cost, likely rideshares, morning timing, free breakfast, in-room coffee, mini-fridge, nearby restaurant access, cancellation cutoff, and standard one-bed room availability, then recommend the reservation to hold.
events.scenario_brief: The Birmingham hosts confirm that Wednesday will start in Avondale at 8:45 a.m. and end with lunch near Railroad Park, while the Thursday debrief remains downtown from 10:30 a.m. to noon. One downtown limited-service hotel has a cancellable rate available for only two more days, and a UAB-area property is modestly cheaper but adds more rideshares. Current constraints are keeping the mornings simple, walking to Tuesday dinner if possible, checking breakfast and room basics, and avoiding a boutique hotel that costs more without useful amenities. The unresolved choice is which refundable hotel to hold.

events.continuity_hook: Moves from the Birmingham hotel hold to final airfare once the event windows are firm.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the remaining round trips by fare, carrier, elapsed time, arrival buffer, Thursday airport margin, and Chicago arrival time, then identify the itinerary to ticket.
events.scenario_brief: With the Birmingham downtown hotel held, Marisol now has firmer meeting windows: Tuesday arrival should allow a hotel bag drop before a 4:45 p.m. welcome, and Thursday lunch is expected to end around 12:30 p.m. Current constraints are flying from Chicago, keeping enough connection or nonstop buffer for the Tuesday arrival, returning after lunch, and not paying a large premium for timing she does not need. The unresolved choice is between the best-timed United nonstop pair and cheaper connecting options that either tighten Tuesday or put her back in Chicago later Thursday evening.

events.continuity_hook: Performs a short Birmingham weather and arrival-margin check after both hotel and flights are in place.
events.interaction_goal: Map the updated door-to-door timing, check the realistic airport-to-hotel buffer, confirm the cancellation deadline and dinner options, and decide whether the current outbound still works.
events.scenario_brief: A few days before the Birmingham trip, thunderstorms are forecast across parts of the Midwest and Southeast, and the airline nudges Marisol's Tuesday outbound later by about half an hour. The hotel notes that mobile check-in is available but early room access is not guaranteed. Current constraints are preserving enough margin for the welcome session, keeping the no-car plan workable with carry-on luggage, knowing the hotel cancellation cutoff, and protecting the Thursday after-lunch return. The unresolved issue is whether to keep the bookings as they are or move to an earlier Tuesday departure while seats remain available.

events.continuity_hook: Starts the next professional episode after the April site visit is finished.
events.interaction_goal: Build a compact comparison of flight and hotel pairings with estimated totals, arrival and return timing, airport transfer choices, meeting access, breakfast details, room basics, and nearby dinner options.
events.scenario_brief: After returning from Birmingham, Marisol begins planning a May 19-21 Minneapolis board committee trip with a Wednesday evening opening dinner, a Thursday full-board session downtown, and Friday committee breakouts expected to end around noon. Current constraints are flying from Chicago, avoiding a rental car, deciding between the event hotel block and lower nearby hotels, and returning Friday after lunch without getting home late. No bookings exist, and the main unresolved issue is whether the event-hotel convenience outweighs a cheaper stay that includes breakfast.

events.continuity_hook: Narrows Minneapolis lodging after the dinner location, Friday timing, and block deadline become firm.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the final hotel choices by total cost, morning timing, breakfast value, room amenities, cancellation terms, luggage convenience, and nearby restaurant access, then recommend which refundable reservation to hold and note any flight-timing implication for the later Friday finish.
events.scenario_brief: Board staff confirm that the Wednesday dinner is two blocks from the event hotel and that Friday committee breakouts may run until 1:00 p.m.; the hotel block deadline is the next morning. Current constraints are avoiding rushed mornings, keeping the lodging total defensible, having an easy breakfast before sessions, checking in-room coffee and mini-fridge details, and making sure any off-block savings are not erased by rideshares. The unresolved choice is whether to reserve the event hotel without included breakfast or a nearby limited-service property with breakfast and a slightly less convenient location.
